notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus: kainin. The bare root 'Kain tayo!' is the everyday invitation.

examples.tl: Kumain na kami sa Jollibee kanina.
examples.en: We already ate at Jollibee earlier.

notes: Actor focus (um- before a vowel root). Object focus: inumin. Said alone it often means drinking alcohol.

examples.tl: Umiinom siya ng kape tuwing umaga.
examples.en: He drinks coffee every morning.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Takes sa + place. Casual invite: 'Punta tayo sa mall.'

examples.tl: Pupunta kami sa BGC mamaya.
examples.en: We're going to BGC later.
examples.taglish: Pupunta kami sa BGC mamaya, sama ka?

notes: Actor focus (um-). 'Uwi na tayo' = let's head home. Object focus iuwi = take something home.

examples.tl: Uuwi na ako, traffic na kasi.
examples.en: I'm heading home now, traffic is building up.

notes: Actor focus (um-). 'Alis!' alone is a blunt 'move/get out'. 'Aalis na ako' = I'm off.

examples.tl: Kanina pa umalis si Marco.
examples.en: Marco left a while ago.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus: bilhin (irregular). Takes ng + the thing bought.

examples.tl: Bumili ako ng ulam sa karinderya.
examples.en: I bought a viand at the eatery.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus: tawagan (call someone). Also 'to call out/shout for'.

examples.tl: Tumawag ang landlord kanina.
examples.en: The landlord called earlier.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Irregular: d becomes r in the reduplicated forms (dumarating, darating).

examples.tl: Darating ang Grab sa loob ng limang minuto.
examples.en: The Grab will arrive within five minutes.
examples.taglish: Darating na yung Grab, five minutes.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Also 'come out/appear' (lumabas ang resulta). 'Labas tayo' = let's go out.

examples.tl: Lalabas kami ngayong gabi.
examples.en: We're going out tonight.

en: to enter; to go to work/school
notes: Actor focus (-um-). In Manila 'pumasok' usually means reporting to work or class. 'Pasok!' = come in.

examples.tl: Pumasok ka ba sa office ngayon?
examples.en: Did you go in to the office today?
examples.taglish: Pumasok ka ba sa office ngayon o WFH?

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus: tulungan (help someone). 'Tulong!' = help!

examples.tl: Tumulong siya sa akin kahapon.
examples.en: He helped me yesterday.

notes: Actor focus (um-). 'Maupo po kayo' is the polite invitation to sit; 'Upo ka' is casual.

examples.tl: Umupo siya sa tabi ko sa jeep.
examples.en: She sat beside me on the jeep.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Root tayo (stress on last syllable), not the pronoun tayo (we).

examples.tl: Tumayo ang lahat nang tumugtog ang Lupang Hinirang.
examples.en: Everyone stood when the national anthem played.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Also 'to set off/leave'. Maglakad = to walk around as an activity.

examples.tl: Lumakad lang kami papuntang Greenbelt.
examples.en: We just walked to Greenbelt.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Also 'to run for office'. Taglish: mag-jogging.

examples.tl: Tumatakbo siya tuwing umaga sa Ayala Triangle.
examples.en: She runs every morning at Ayala Triangle.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Takes ng/sa + vehicle. 'Sakay!' = hop in. Opposite: bumaba.

examples.tl: Sumakay kami ng jeep papuntang Guadalupe.
examples.en: We rode a jeep to Guadalupe.

en: to go down; to get off
notes: Actor focus (-um-). On a jeep: 'Bababa ako sa kanto' or just 'Para!' to stop.

examples.tl: Bababa ako sa kanto, ha.
examples.en: I'll get off at the corner, okay?

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Takes ng + the thing requested. Humingi ng tawad = apologize.

examples.tl: Humingi siya ng tulong sa guard.
examples.en: He asked the guard for help.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus is irregular: kunin. Also 'to take a photo' (kumuha ng picture).

examples.tl: Kumuha ako ng tubig sa ref.
examples.en: I got some water from the fridge.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus: gawin. Gumawa ng paraan = find a way.

examples.tl: Gumawa siya ng paraan para makarating.
examples.en: He found a way to get there.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). 'Babalik ako' = I'll be back. Object focus ibalik = return something.

examples.tl: Babalik ako bukas ng umaga.
examples.en: I'll come back tomorrow morning.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus: sagutin. Also 'to shoulder the cost' (ako ang sasagot).

examples.tl: Hindi siya sumagot sa text ko.
examples.en: He didn't reply to my text.
examples.taglish: Hindi siya sumagot sa text ko, seen lang.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Object focus: tingnan. In a store 'Tumitingin lang po' = just browsing.

examples.tl: Tumitingin lang po kami.
examples.en: We're just looking, thanks.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Tawanan = to laugh at someone. Nakakatawa = funny.

examples.tl: Tumawa lang siya nang sabihin ko.
examples.en: She just laughed when I said it.

notes: Actor focus (um-). Iyakin = crybaby. Umiiyak = is crying.

examples.tl: Umiyak ang baby buong gabi.
examples.en: The baby cried all night.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Magkanta also common. Root from Spanish cantar. Kantahin = sing a song.

examples.tl: Kumanta siya sa videoke hanggang alas-dos.
examples.en: He sang videoke until 2 a.m.

notes: Actor focus (um-). Umuulan = it's raining; uulan daw = they say it will rain.

examples.tl: Umuulan na naman sa Makati.
examples.en: It's raining again in Makati.
examples.taglish: Umuulan na naman, baha na siguro sa Taft.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Moving house, jobs, seats, networks. Ilipat = move something.

examples.tl: Lumipat kami ng condo noong Hunyo.
examples.en: We moved condos in June.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). 'Lumapit ka' = come closer. Malapit = near.

examples.tl: Lumapit ang bata at humingi ng barya.
examples.en: The kid came up and asked for coins.

en: to go along; to come with
notes: Actor focus (-um-). 'Sama ka?' = coming along? Isama = bring someone along; samahan = accompany.

examples.tl: Sasama ako sa inyo sa Tagaytay.
examples.en: I'll go with you guys to Tagaytay.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). 'Susunod' also means 'next' (susunod na linggo). Sundin = follow a rule.

examples.tl: Sumunod lang kami sa Waze.
examples.en: We just followed Waze.

notes: Actor focus (-um-). Daily Manila life: pumila sa MRT, sa bangko, sa LTO. Pila = the line.

examples.tl: Pumila kami ng isang oras sa MRT.
examples.en: We lined up for an hour at the MRT.

notes: Ability actor focus (maka-). Nakakain = managed to eat. The 'ka' reduplicates: nakakakain.

examples.tl: Hindi ako nakakain ng lunch kasi back-to-back ang meetings.
examples.en: I didn't get to eat lunch because meetings were back-to-back.

notes: Ability actor focus (maka-). 'Nakapunta ka na ba sa...?' = have you ever been to...?

examples.tl: Nakapunta ka na ba sa Siargao?
examples.en: Have you ever been to Siargao?

en: to fall asleep; to manage to sleep
notes: Ability actor focus (maka-). Nakatulog = fell asleep (vs natulog = went to bed).

examples.tl: Nakatulog ako sa bus pauwi.
examples.en: I fell asleep on the bus going home.

notes: Ability actor focus (maka-). 'Nakauwi ka na?' is the standard check-in text after a night out.

examples.tl: Nakauwi ka na ba? Ingat.
examples.en: Did you make it home yet? Take care.

notes: Potentive object focus (ma- + kausap): the person spoken to is the subject. 'Nakausap ko na siya' = I got to talk to him.

examples.tl: Nakausap ko na ang admin tungkol sa parking.
examples.en: I already got to talk to the admin about parking.

notes: Ability actor focus (maka-). Hindi ako nakabili = I wasn't able to buy.

examples.tl: Hindi ako nakabili ng load kanina.
examples.en: I wasn't able to buy load earlier.

en: to tag along; to go along with
notes: Social actor focus (maki-): join someone already doing it. Nakisabay sa kotse = rode along.

examples.tl: Nakisabay ako sa kotse ni Jen pauwi.
examples.en: I rode along in Jen's car going home.

en: to plead; to ask a favor
notes: Request actor focus (maki-). 'Nakikiusap ako' = I'm begging you / please, I'm asking.

examples.tl: Nakikiusap ako, pakibaba naman ng volume.
examples.en: I'm asking nicely, please turn the volume down.

notes: Request actor focus (maki-). Root daan, d becomes r. 'Makikiraan po' is the standard excuse-me when squeezing past.

examples.tl: Makikiraan po.
examples.en: Excuse me, coming through.

notes: Request actor focus (maki-): ride in someone else's vehicle.

examples.tl: Nakisakay lang ako sa kanila hanggang Ayala.
examples.en: I just hitched a ride with them up to Ayala.

notes: Request actor focus (maki-). 'Makikigamit po ng CR' = may I use the restroom.

examples.tl: Makikigamit po ng CR.
examples.en: May I use the restroom, please?

notes: Causative actor focus (magpa-): have someone cut your hair. The 'pa' reduplicates: nagpapagupit.

examples.tl: Nagpagupit ako sa barbero sa kanto.
examples.en: I got a haircut at the corner barber.

notes: Causative actor focus (magpa-): have something fixed or arranged. Also 'get your hair/makeup done'.

examples.tl: Nagpaayos kami ng aircon noong Sabado.
examples.en: We had the aircon fixed on Saturday.

notes: Taglish causative (magpa- + load): have a store load your prepaid number. Mag-load = top up yourself in an app.

examples.tl: Nagpa-load ako ng 100 sa sari-sari store.
examples.en: I topped up 100 pesos at the corner store.

notes: Causative actor focus (magpa-): have something carried/delivered. Object focus: ipadala.

examples.tl: Nagpadala siya ng pera sa pamilya niya sa probinsya.
examples.en: He sent money to his family in the province.

en: to say goodbye; to ask permission
notes: Actor focus (magpa- + alam): let someone know you're leaving. 'Magpapaalam na ako' = I'll say goodbye now.

examples.tl: Nagpaalam na siya sa boss niya kasi may lakad.
examples.en: She told her boss she was leaving because she had plans.

en: to get checked by a doctor
notes: Causative actor focus (magpa-): have yourself looked at. Magpatingin sa doktor / sa dentista.

examples.tl: Nagpatingin ako sa doktor kasi tatlong araw na akong may lagnat.
examples.en: I saw a doctor because I had had a fever for three days.

notes: Causative actor focus (magpa-): commission work from someone. Object focus: ipagawa.

examples.tl: Magpapagawa kami ng cabinet sa kwarto.
examples.en: We're having a cabinet made for the bedroom.

notes: Taglish causative (magpa- + picture). 'Magpa-picture tayo!' = let's take a photo of us.

examples.tl: Nagpa-picture kami sa harap ng Rizal Monument.
examples.en: We had our picture taken in front of the Rizal Monument.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: lutuin. Nagluluto = is cooking. Luto = cooked.

examples.tl: Nagluto si Ate ng adobo para sa lunch.
examples.en: Ate cooked adobo for lunch.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: linisin. Malinis = clean (adj).

examples.tl: Naglinis kami ng condo buong Linggo.
examples.en: We cleaned the condo all Sunday.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). For dishes, hands, cars; clothes are maglaba. Object focus: hugasan.

examples.tl: Ako na maghuhugas ng plato.
examples.en: I'll wash the dishes.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Labahan = laundry shop; labandera = laundrywoman. Root from Spanish lavar.

examples.tl: Naglalaba siya tuwing Sabado.
examples.en: He does laundry every Saturday.

en: to get dressed; to change clothes
notes: Actor focus (mag-). 'Magbibihis lang ako' = let me just change. Bihisan = dress someone.

examples.tl: Nagbihis muna siya bago lumabas.
examples.en: She changed first before going out.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Hyphen before a vowel root; the vowel reduplicates: nag-aaral. Also 'to attend school'.

examples.tl: Nag-aaral siya sa Mapua.
examples.en: She studies at Mapua.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Reduplicate the first consonant + vowel (ta): nagtatrabaho. Taglish: mag-work.

examples.tl: Nagtatrabaho siya sa isang BPO sa Ortigas.
examples.en: He works at a BPO in Ortigas.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Magsalita ng Tagalog = speak Tagalog. Mag-usap = converse with someone.

examples.tl: Nagsasalita ba siya ng Tagalog?
examples.en: Does he speak Tagalog?

en: to walk around; to take a walk
notes: Actor focus (mag-): walking as an activity. Lumakad = walk or set off toward somewhere.

examples.tl: Naglalakad kami sa Ayala Triangle tuwing gabi.
examples.en: We walk around Ayala Triangle every evening.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: bayaran. 'Bayad po' when passing fare on a jeep.

examples.tl: Nagbayad na ako ng kuryente sa GCash.
examples.en: I already paid the electric bill on GCash.

notes: Taglish actor focus (mag- + order). Umorder also heard. The vowel reduplicates: nag-oorder.

examples.tl: Nag-order kami sa Grab kasi tinatamad magluto.
examples.en: We ordered on Grab because we felt too lazy to cook.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Pahinga (pa- + hinga 'breath') acts as the root. 'Pahinga muna' = rest first.

examples.tl: Nagpahinga muna kami sa 7-Eleven.
examples.en: We rested a bit at the 7-Eleven first.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: hintayin. 'Hintay lang' / 'Wait lang' = hold on.

examples.tl: Naghintay kami ng isang oras ng Grab.
examples.en: We waited an hour for a Grab.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: hanapin. Humanap also used.

examples.tl: Naghahanap siya ng bagong trabaho.
examples.en: He's looking for a new job.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: basahin. Bumasa also used. Root basa (read) stresses the 1st syllable.

examples.tl: Nagbabasa siya ng libro sa MRT.
examples.en: She reads a book on the MRT.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: isulat. Sumulat also used. Sulat = letter.

examples.tl: Nagsusulat siya ng blog tungkol sa pagkain.
examples.en: He writes a blog about food.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: dalhin (irregular). 'May dala ka ba?' = did you bring anything?

examples.tl: Nagdala ako ng payong kasi baka umulan.
examples.en: I brought an umbrella in case it rains.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: ibigay (the thing); recipient focus: bigyan (the person).

examples.tl: Nagbigay siya ng tip sa rider.
examples.en: He gave the rider a tip.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: simulan. 'Nagsimula na' = it has started. Taglish: mag-start.

examples.tl: Nagsimula na ang meeting nang dumating ako.
examples.en: The meeting had already started when I arrived.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Tanungin = ask someone; itanong = ask the question itself.

examples.tl: Nagtanong ako sa guard kung saan ang exit.
examples.en: I asked the guard where the exit was.

en: to meet up; to see each other
notes: Reciprocal actor focus (mag-): two people see each other. 'Kita tayo' = see you. Makita = to see.

examples.tl: Magkikita kami sa Glorietta mamaya.
examples.en: We're meeting up at Glorietta later.
examples.taglish: Magkikita kami sa Glorietta mamaya, around 6.

en: to talk; to have a conversation
notes: Reciprocal actor focus (mag-). Kausapin = to talk to someone. 'Usap tayo' = let's talk.

examples.tl: Nag-usap kami nang matagal sa phone.
examples.en: We talked on the phone for a long time.

notes: Reciprocal actor focus (mag-). 'Nag-away kami' = we had a fight. Awayin = pick a fight with.

examples.tl: Nag-away sila dahil sa pera.
examples.en: They fought over money.

notes: Actor focus (magka- + mali 'wrong'); the 'ka' reduplicates: nagkakamali. 'Nagkamali ako' = my bad.

examples.tl: Nagkamali ako ng baba, sa Buendia pa pala.
examples.en: I got off at the wrong stop; it was Buendia, it turns out.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Taglish mag-drive is just as common. Root from Spanish manejar.

examples.tl: Hindi ako nagmamaneho sa Manila, nakaka-stress.
examples.en: I don't drive in Manila, it's stressful.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus buksan is more common. Bukas (stress on 2nd syllable) also = tomorrow.

examples.tl: Nagbukas ang bagong coffee shop sa Poblacion.
examples.en: A new coffee shop opened in Poblacion.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: isara. 'Nagsara na' = closed for the day or for good. Sarado = closed.

examples.tl: Nagsasara ang mall ng alas-diyes.
examples.en: The mall closes at ten.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). With a consonant cluster, reduplicate only pa: nagpaplano. Planuhin = plan something.

examples.tl: Nagpaplano kami ng trip sa Palawan.
examples.en: We're planning a trip to Palawan.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Maglaro ng basketball / ng ML (Mobile Legends). Laruan = toy.

examples.tl: Naglalaro ng basketball ang mga bata sa court.
examples.en: The kids are playing basketball at the court.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). 'Ingat!' or 'Ingat ka' is the everyday 'take care' farewell.

examples.tl: Nag-iingat kami pag-uwi ng gabi.
examples.en: We're careful when going home at night.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: mahalin. Mahal also = expensive. Letters end 'Nagmamahal, ...'.

examples.tl: Nagmahal siya ng taong hindi siya mahal.
examples.en: He loved someone who didn't love him back.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Object focus: ituro (also 'to point out'). Guro/teacher.

examples.tl: Nagtuturo siya ng English online.
examples.en: She teaches English online.

notes: Taglish actor focus (mag- + text). Reduplication 'nagte-text' is also written nagtetext. Object: i-text (mo ako).

examples.tl: Nag-text siya na late siya.
examples.en: He texted that he's running late.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). 'Nag-iipon ako para sa...' = I'm saving up for... Ipon = savings.

examples.tl: Nag-iipon ako para sa bagong motor.
examples.en: I'm saving up for a new motorbike.

notes: Actor focus (mag-): change by itself or change one's ways. Bago = new. Baguhin = change something.

examples.tl: Nagbago na ang schedule ng MRT.
examples.en: The MRT schedule has changed.

notes: Actor focus (mag-). Everyday household verb. Kanin = cooked rice; bigas = uncooked rice.

examples.tl: Nagsaing ka na ba? Wala na tayong kanin.
examples.en: Did you cook rice yet? We have no rice left.

notes: Actor focus (ma-). Natutulog = is sleeping. Makatulog = to fall asleep. Tulog = asleep.

examples.tl: Natulog ako ng alas-dos kagabi.
examples.en: I went to sleep at 2 a.m. last night.

notes: Object focus (ma-, perception). 'Nakita ko' = I saw it. 'Nakikita mo ba?' = can you see it?

examples.tl: Nakita ko si Paolo sa Landmark kanina.
examples.en: I saw Paolo at Landmark earlier.

notes: Object focus (ma-, perception). Root dinig: d becomes r after the prefix (ma-rinig, na-ririnig).

examples.tl: Narinig ko yung sinabi mo.
examples.en: I heard what you said.

notes: Object focus (ma-...-an). 'Hindi ko maintindihan' = I don't understand. Taglish: na-gets ko.

examples.tl: Naintindihan mo ba yung sinabi ng driver?
examples.en: Did you understand what the driver said?
examples.taglish: Na-gets mo ba yung sinabi ng driver?

notes: Actor focus (ma-). Matuto ng Tagalog / matutong magluto. Reduplicate tu: natututo.

examples.tl: Natututo na akong mag-Tagalog.
examples.en: I'm learning to speak Tagalog.

notes: Object focus (ma-). Root alaala; ma- + alaala contracts to maalala. 'Naalala ko!' = oh, I remember now.

examples.tl: Naalala ko na kung saan ko nilagay ang susi.
examples.en: I remember now where I put the key.

en: to find out; to come to know
notes: Object focus (ma-...-an) of alam. 'Nalaman ko' = I found out. For plain 'I know' just say 'alam ko'.

examples.tl: Nalaman ko lang kahapon na lilipat na siya.
examples.en: I only found out yesterday that she's moving.

notes: Object focus (ma- + ka-...-an) of limot. 'Nakalimutan ko' = I forgot. Shorter kalimutan is also used.

examples.tl: Nakalimutan ko ang wallet ko sa condo.
examples.en: I forgot my wallet at the condo.

notes: State focus (ma-, not mag-). 'Nagugutom na ako' = I'm getting hungry. 'Gutom na ako' = I'm hungry.

examples.tl: Nagugutom na ako, kain na tayo.
examples.en: I'm getting hungry, let's eat.

notes: State focus (ma-). 'Napagod ako' = I got tired. 'Pagod ako' = I'm tired. Nakakapagod = tiring.

examples.tl: Napagod ako sa commute, dalawang oras one way.
examples.en: I got tired from the commute, two hours one way.

en: to be late; to get caught
notes: Actor focus (ma-). 'Nahuli ako' = I was late or I got caught, by context. Taglish: na-late.

examples.tl: Nahuli ako sa meeting kasi traffic sa EDSA.
examples.en: I was late to the meeting because of traffic on EDSA.

notes: Actor focus (ma-, not mag-). Naliligo = is showering. 'Ligo muna ako' = let me shower first.

examples.tl: Maliligo lang ako tapos alis na tayo.
examples.en: I'll just shower and then we'll leave.

notes: State/object focus (ma-). 'Natapos na' = it's done. Tapusin = finish something. Tapos = done; also 'then'.

examples.tl: Natapos na ang shift ko ng alas-sais.
examples.en: My shift ended at six.

notes: Actor focus (ma-). Root patay: the p becomes m (ma-matay). Also for batteries, phones, lights going dead.

examples.tl: Namatay ang phone ko sa kalagitnaan ng call.
examples.en: My phone died in the middle of the call.

en: to run out; to be used up
notes: State focus (ma-). Naubos na ang load / kanin / pera. Ubusin = finish it all off.

examples.tl: Naubos na ang load ko.
examples.en: My phone load is all used up.

notes: State focus (ma-). 'Nawala ang wallet ko' = my wallet got lost. 'Nawawala' = is missing.

examples.tl: Nawala ang signal sa loob ng elevator.
examples.en: The signal dropped inside the elevator.

notes: Actor focus (ma-). 'Nahulog ang phone ko' = my phone fell. Also 'fall in love' (nahulog ang loob).

examples.tl: Nahulog ang phone ko sa sahig ng jeep.
examples.en: My phone fell on the jeep floor.

notes: State focus (ma-). 'Nasira ang aircon' = the aircon broke. Sira = broken. Sirain = break something.

examples.tl: Nasira ang aircon namin, init na init.
examples.en: Our aircon broke, it's so hot.

notes: State focus (ma-). Root basa 'wet' (stress on 2nd syllable). Same spelling as basa 'read', so mabasa can also mean 'manage to read'.

examples.tl: Nabasa ako sa ulan pauwi.
examples.en: I got soaked in the rain going home.

notes: Emotion focus (ma-). 'Natatakot ako' = I'm scared. 'Takot ako sa ipis' = I'm scared of cockroaches.

examples.tl: Natakot ako nang lumindol kagabi.
examples.en: I got scared when the earthquake hit last night.

notes: Emotion focus (ma-, not mag-). 'Nagalit siya' = he got mad. 'Galit ka?' = are you mad?

examples.tl: Nagalit si Mama kasi late ako umuwi.
examples.en: Mom got mad because I came home late.

notes: Actor focus (ma-/mang-). Root bili: b becomes m (ma-mili). Also 'to choose' (mamili ka).

examples.tl: Namili kami sa Divisoria para sa Pasko.
examples.en: We went shopping in Divisoria for Christmas.

notes: Irregular linking verb (ma- + -ging, no separate root). Naging = became/was; nagiging = is becoming; magiging = will be.

examples.tl: Naging mahirap ang commute noong bumaha.
examples.en: The commute became hard when it flooded.

en: to meet; to get to know
notes: Object focus (ma-): the person met is the subject. 'Nakilala ko siya' = I met him. Kilala = known / acquainted.

examples.tl: Nakilala ko siya sa isang party sa Poblacion.
examples.en: I met her at a party in Poblacion.

notes: Taglish state verb (ma- + late). 'Na-late ako' = I was late. The reduplicated 'le' spelling varies in texts (nalelate).

examples.tl: Na-late ako kasi traffic sa Buendia.
examples.en: I was late because of traffic on Buendia.

notes: Object focus (-in). Completed uses the -in- infix: kinain. 'Kainin mo na' = eat it now.

examples.tl: Kinain ng pusa ang tira.
examples.en: The cat ate the leftovers.

notes: Object focus (-in); o becomes u: inumin. Vowel root takes in- prefix: ininom. Inumin as a noun = a drink.

examples.tl: Ininom ko na yung gamot kanina.
examples.en: I already took the medicine earlier.

notes: Object focus (-in). Irregular: bili + -in drops a vowel: bilhin (not bilihin). Completed binili.

examples.tl: Binili ko yung sapatos online kasi sale.
examples.en: I bought those shoes online since they were on sale.

notes: Object focus (-in). Irregular: kuha + -in = kunin, but completed/incompleted keep kuha (kinuha, kinukuha).

examples.tl: Kinuha ko na ang package sa lobby.
examples.en: I already picked up the package from the lobby.

notes: Object focus (-in). Gawa + -in = gawin (a drops out). 'Anong ginagawa mo?' = what are you doing?

examples.tl: Anong ginagawa mo ngayon?
examples.en: What are you doing right now?

notes: Object focus (-in). Root sabi + -hin. 'Sabi ko' = I said. Sabihan = tell someone.

examples.tl: Sinabi ko na sa kanya kahapon.
examples.en: I already told him yesterday.

notes: Directional focus (-an): the person called is the subject. Tawagin = call someone by name / summon.

examples.tl: Tatawagan kita mamaya pag free na ako.
examples.en: I'll call you later when I'm free.

notes: Object focus (-in). Completed infixes -in- after h: hinintay. 'Hintayin mo ako' = wait for me.

examples.tl: Hinihintay ko pa yung rider.
examples.en: I'm still waiting for the rider.
examples.taglish: Hinihintay ko pa yung Grab rider, 10 mins pa daw.

notes: Object focus (-in). 'Hinahanap ka ni boss' = the boss is looking for you.

examples.tl: Hinahanap ka ni Ma'am kanina.
examples.en: Ma'am was looking for you earlier.

notes: Object focus (-in); o becomes u: lutuin. Roots starting with l use ni- for completed: niluto (older: linuto).

examples.tl: Niluto ni Lola ang sinigang para sa lahat.
examples.en: Grandma cooked sinigang for everyone.

notes: Object focus (-in). Roots starting with l take ni- instead of the -in- infix: nilinis, nililinis.

examples.tl: Nilinis ko na ang CR.
examples.en: I already cleaned the bathroom.

notes: Object focus (-an). 'Hugasan mo ang plato' = wash the dishes. Hugasan as a noun = the sink.

examples.tl: Hinugasan ko na ang mga plato.
examples.en: I already washed the dishes.

notes: Object focus (-an). Root bayad: d becomes r before -an. 'Babayaran ko' = I'll pay for it.

examples.tl: Babayaran ko na lang yung kuryente sa GCash.
examples.en: I'll just pay the electric bill on GCash.

notes: Object focus (i-): the thing given is the subject. Completed: i- + b-in-igay = ibinigay. Bigyan = give to someone.

examples.tl: Ibinigay ko ang sukli sa driver.
examples.en: I gave the change to the driver.

notes: Object focus (i-). Isinulat = wrote it. Sulatan = write to someone. Taglish: i-type.

examples.tl: Isinulat ko ang address sa resibo.
examples.en: I wrote the address on the receipt.

notes: Beneficiary focus (i-): the person you buy for is the subject. 'Ibili mo ako ng tubig' = buy me water.

examples.tl: Ibinili niya ako ng kape sa 7-Eleven.
examples.en: She bought me coffee at 7-Eleven.

notes: Object focus (-in). Irregular: dala + -in drops a vowel: dalhin. Completed dinala. 'Dalhin mo' = bring it.

examples.tl: Dinala ko ang laptop sa office.
examples.en: I brought the laptop to the office.

notes: Object focus (i-). Vowel root: completed is ini- + uwi = iniuwi. 'Iuuwi ko' = I'll take it home.

examples.tl: Iniuwi niya yung tirang pizza.
examples.en: He took the leftover pizza home.

notes: Object focus (i-). 'Ibabalik ko' = I'll return it. Bumalik = to come back (actor focus).

examples.tl: Ibinalik ko na ang susi sa guard.
examples.en: I already returned the key to the guard.

notes: Object focus (i-). Roots starting with l take ini- in the completed: inilagay. 'Ilagay mo dito' = put it here.

examples.tl: Saan mo inilagay ang remote?
examples.en: Where did you put the remote?

notes: Object focus (i-). Completed: i- + t-in-apon = itinapon. Basurahan = trash can.

examples.tl: Itinapon ko na yung expired na gatas.
examples.en: I already threw out the expired milk.

notes: Object focus (-an). Irregular: bukas + -an drops a vowel: buksan. Also 'turn on' (buksan mo ang ilaw).

examples.tl: Binuksan ko ang aircon pagdating ko.
examples.en: I turned on the aircon when I arrived.

notes: Object focus (i-). 'Isara mo ang pinto' = close the door. For lights/appliances, 'turn off' is patayin.

examples.tl: Isinara niya ang bintana kasi umuulan.
examples.en: She closed the window because it was raining.

notes: Object focus (i- + pa- + dala) of magpadala. Completed ipinadala; ipinadadala also heard. 'Ipapadala ko' = I'll send it.

examples.tl: Ipinadala ko na yung documents via LBC.
examples.en: I already sent the documents via LBC.

notes: Object focus (i-). 'Ituro mo sa akin' = teach/show me. Also 'to point at'.

examples.tl: Itinuro niya sa akin kung paano mag-GCash.
examples.en: He taught me how to use GCash.

notes: Object focus (i- + pa- + kita). Completed ipinakita; ipinakikita also heard. Casual short form: 'Pakita mo'.

examples.tl: Ipinakita ko ang QR code sa cashier.
examples.en: I showed the QR code to the cashier.

notes: Object focus (-in): the person asked is the subject; o becomes u. Itanong = ask the question itself.

examples.tl: Tinanong ko ang guard kung saan ang CR.
examples.en: I asked the guard where the restroom was.

notes: Object focus (-in); o becomes u: sagutin. Also 'to pay for' (sasagutin ko ang bill).

examples.tl: Hindi niya sinagot ang tawag ko.
examples.en: He didn't answer my call.

notes: Object focus (-in). Root bisita + -hin. Native synonym: dalawin. Bumisita = actor focus.

examples.tl: Binisita namin si Lolo sa Bulacan.
examples.en: We visited Grandpa in Bulacan.

en: to go to (a place or person)
notes: Directional focus (-an): the place or person gone to is the subject. 'Pupuntahan kita' = I'll come to you.

examples.tl: Pupuntahan kita sa office mo mamaya.
examples.en: I'll come by your office later.

notes: Object focus (-an): the person helped is the subject; o becomes u. 'Tulungan mo ako' = help me.

examples.tl: Tinulungan ako ng kapitbahay magbuhat ng ref.
examples.en: The neighbor helped me carry the fridge.

notes: Object focus (-an). Vowel root: completed is in- + alaga = inalagaan. Alaga as a noun = pet / ward.

examples.tl: Inaalagaan niya ang lola niya sa bahay.
examples.en: She takes care of her grandmother at home.

notes: Object focus (-in). More deliberate than maintindihan; also 'to mind'. 'Wag mo nang intindihin' = don't mind it.

examples.tl: Hindi ko inintindi ang sinabi niya.
examples.en: I didn't pay attention to what he said.

notes: Object focus (-in); o becomes u: ayusin. Vowel root: completed is in- + ayos = inayos. Ayos = okay / in order.

examples.tl: Inaayos pa ng technician ang internet.
examples.en: The technician is still fixing the internet.

notes: Object focus (-an); o becomes u: subukan. 'Subukan mo' = try it. Taglish: i-try mo.

examples.tl: Sinubukan ko ang bagong ramen place sa Salcedo.
examples.en: I tried the new ramen place in Salcedo.

notes: Object focus (-an). Irregular: tingin + -an drops a vowel: tingnan. Completed tiningnan. 'Tingnan mo' = look.

examples.tl: Tiningnan ko ang Waze, red lahat.
examples.en: I checked Waze, everything was red.

notes: Object focus (-in). Root basa + -hin. 'Binasa ko' = I read it. Babasahin as a noun = reading material.

examples.tl: Binasa mo ba yung message ko?
examples.en: Did you read my message?

notes: Object focus (ka-...-an) of limot; o becomes u. Mostly a command: 'Kalimutan mo na' = forget it. Everyday past: nakalimutan.

examples.tl: Kinalimutan na niya ang nangyari.
examples.en: She has let go of what happened.

en: to remember; to keep in mind
notes: Object focus (-in) of alaala. 'Alalahanin mo' = keep in mind. Also 'to worry about' (inaalala kita).

examples.tl: Aalalahanin ko ang sinabi mo.
examples.en: I'll keep in mind what you said.

notes: Object focus (-in): the loved one is the subject. 'Mahal kita' is the usual 'I love you'; minamahal = beloved.

examples.tl: Minahal niya ang Pilipinas na parang sariling bayan.
examples.en: He loved the Philippines like his own country.

notes: Object focus (-in) of gusto; o becomes u. Everyday 'I want' is just 'gusto ko'. Mostly in 'kung gugustuhin mo' = if you want to.

examples.tl: Kung gugustuhin mo, pwede kang mag-stay dito.
examples.en: If you want, you can stay here.

notes: Recipient focus (-an). Irregular: bigay + -an drops a vowel: bigyan. 'Bigyan mo ako ng...' = give me...

examples.tl: Binigyan niya ako ng discount.
examples.en: She gave me a discount.

notes: Object focus (ka- + usap + -in): the person spoken to is the subject. 'Kausapin mo siya' = talk to him.

examples.tl: Kinausap ko ang landlord tungkol sa deposit.
examples.en: I talked to the landlord about the deposit.

notes: Object focus (-an): the person accompanied is the subject. 'Samahan mo ako' = come with me.

examples.tl: Sinamahan ko siya sa ospital.
examples.en: I went with her to the hospital.

notes: Object focus (-in). In daily life mostly 'turn off' (patayin mo ang ilaw/aircon). Pinatay = turned off / killed.

examples.tl: Pinatay ko na ang aircon bago umalis.
examples.en: I turned off the aircon before leaving.

notes: Object focus (-in); o becomes u: sunduin. For picking up a person (sundo); for things use kunin.

examples.tl: Susunduin kita sa airport bukas.
examples.en: I'll pick you up at the airport tomorrow.

notes: Object focus (i-). Roots starting with h take ini- in the completed: inihatid. Hatid-sundo = drop-off and pick-up.

examples.tl: Inihatid niya ako sa NAIA Terminal 3.
examples.en: He dropped me off at NAIA Terminal 3.
